name: Lost!
label: Quest
description: Lost!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've got to help me, friend! My friend, Ringo left earlier to explore the volcano to the south of here, and he has been gone way too long. I am really worried about him.
Do you think you could find him? Why don't you take my canteen with you -- if you do find Ringo, I'm sure he'll need it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh... I'm so glad someone found me...
